ranking.rationale: Owns compact support-free cam, roll, rock and crisp repeated motion; the loose chick-as-cam is the core magic.
Strong kinetic-machine fit, but Neststomp is a tiny direct-touch mechanism rather than a dramatic multi-element machine.
Understands legible endpoint transformations, but the concept is a balance-transfer cam rather than deployment.
Strong owl-and-chick character relationship, but the hard problem is mechanism rather than a miniature world.
Compact robust few-part construction fits, though there is no tactile puzzle or reveal.
Captive-motion expertise is adjacent, but there are no loops, crossings, or topology-driven paths.
The cam is physically legible, but the Wish is not a science-first explanatory object.
Flat-print discipline helps fabrication, but this is not a modular pattern system.
The owl silhouette is important, but no projected shadow story is intended.
No optical, aperture, moire, or light transformation.
Not a personalized known tabletop classic.
